Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with relative lymphopenia, monocytosis, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). INR is significantly prolonged. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
